subject: axolotl
pitch:
Category: Animal.
Subject: axolotl with frilly pink gills.
Style: chibi.

spec.name: Chibi Axolotl
spec.description: A chibi axolotl with an oversized round head, a wide sleepy smile, stubby legs and six frilly pink gill stalks fanning from its cheeks.
spec.layout: A chibi axolotl facing +Z, standing on four stubby legs at y=0. The silhouette is dominated by the head: a wide, slightly squashed sphere centred at [0, 0.17, 0.13] (radius ~0.15) that takes almost half the model's length and overhangs a tiny plump torso behind it. The face reads at a glance: two huge glossy black bead eyes with white highlights low and wide on the front, pink blush discs under them, a wide gentle smile line curved across the lower front, two tiny nostril dots, and a cream chin/lower-jaw piece that sits slightly inside the head so the mouth can open. Behind and above the eyes, three gill stalks per side sprout from the head's flanks (upper-front, mid, lower-back) and sweep outward and back in a fan; every stalk carries rows of soft frilly filaments in pink-to-magenta, the signature feature, built richest. The torso is a short capsule from z=+0.05 back to z=-0.15, pale pink on top with a cream belly, blended under the head. Four stubby legs (front pair at z=+0.05, back pair at z=-0.10, hips at x=±0.085) drop straight down to round feet with three toes each, all touching y=0. The tail continues the torso line, tapering from the rump to a curled tip at z=-0.30, framed by pale translucent-looking dorsal and ventral fin folds. Everything is soft, round and toy-like: low-poly facets, no sharp edges, colour doing the work (warm pale pink up top, cream below, saturated magenta-pink only on the gills and blush so the face and gills pop).

parts.builds: The oversized chibi head and its whole face. One wide low-poly sphere (slightly squashed: scale ~[1.05, 0.92, 0.95], radius 0.15, centre [0, 0.17, 0.13]) in bodyPink, skinned over the head joint. Face pieces seated on its front surface: two huge glossy eyes (black ink spheres ~0.035 with small glossWhite highlight dots offset up-and-out, placed low and wide at roughly x=±0.065, y=0.15, z=0.26 facing forward), soft blush discs in blush under and slightly outboard of each eye, a wide gentle smile built as a thin curved extruded arc in ink across the lower front at y≈0.085 with small upturned corners, two tiny nostril dots in nostril above the smile, and faint ink eyelid crease lines above each eye. The lower jaw is a separate shallow cream (bellyCream) chin piece — a squashed half-sphere seated under the jaw joint at [0, 0.095, 0.20] — tucked inside the head silhouette so the mouth can open; the smile sits on the head, the chin on the jaw. A few tiny bodyShadow freckle dots scatter on the top of the head. All face details are their own parts in their own palette colours, seated flush on the head surface.
parts.attaches: Head sphere blends over the neckSocket mount at [0, 0.16, 0.06] where it meets the torso; chin rides the jaw joint; the gillRowL/gillRowR mounts on the head's flanks are left clear for the gills part.

parts.builds: The six frilly external gills, the model's signature feature. Each of the six gill chains (gillL1..gillL3tip and mirrored R) carries one swept stalk: a tapered tube from its base joint to its tip joint, radius ~0.016 tapering to ~0.007, coloured gillPink with the last third in gillDeep, capped round. From each stalk sprout the frills: along both sides of every stalk, two rows of 6-8 small tapered filaments (thin swept spikes or tiny curved rods ~0.05-0.07 long) angled backward off the stalk like a bottlebrush, coloured gillTip near the base shifting to gillPink at the tips, plus one longer hero filament at each stalk tip in gillTip. Filaments get slightly denser toward the tip so each gill reads as a soft feather duster. The six stalks fan out symmetrically: upper pair angled up-and-back, mid pair straight out, lower pair drooping slightly, all curving back toward -Z so nothing covers the face.
parts.attaches: Each stalk base buries itself into the head sphere at the gillRowL/gillRowR mount region, riding the gill chain joints parented to head.

parts.builds: The plump little body under and behind the head. A smooth capsule swept along the spine from the neckSocket mount [0, 0.16, 0.06] back to the tailRoot mount [0, 0.14, -0.13], radius ~0.10 bulging to 0.105 at the belly, in bodyPink with a countershaded bellyCream underside (paint or a separate belly panel part in bellyCream wrapping the lower half). A pair of tiny shoulder humps in bodyShadow hint at the front legs, and a small smooth bulge where the tail joins. The top line is a gentle arch from the head down to the rump. The torso stays simple so the head, gills and tail carry the character; its only details are the belly colour split with a soft irregular boundary and two tiny bodyShadow speckles on each flank.
parts.attaches: Front blends into the head at neckSocket; rear hands off to the tail at tailRoot; its underside is open to the four leg hips on the legRowFront/legRowBack mounts.

parts.builds: Four stubby chibi legs, each riding its leg joint (legFL, legFR, legBL, legBR). Each leg is a short tapered tube from the hip at [±0.085, 0.085, 0.05 or -0.1] straight down to the foot, radius ~0.032 tapering to ~0.024, in bodyPink with a subtle bodyShadow underside. The foot is a rounded pad (squashed sphere ~0.032 radius) resting exactly on y=0, in bellyCream, with three short forward-splayed toes: tiny tapered capsules ~0.035 long fanned in a V, each tipped with a small toePad ball in toePad. Front toes point forward (+Z), back toes slightly outward. Feet are flat enough that the whole model rests on these eight ground contacts.
parts.attaches: Each hip tube's top tucks up into the torso underside at the legRowFront/legRowBack mounts, riding the leg joints parented to body.

parts.builds: The tapering tail and its fin folds. A swept tube along the tail chain (tail1..tail3) from the tailRoot mount [0, 0.14, -0.13] to a curled tip near [0, 0.15, -0.30], radius 0.085 tapering smoothly to ~0.01 with the last stretch curling slightly upward, in bodyPink. Framing it, an axial fin: two thin membranes (fin membrane colour) — a dorsal one running along the tail's top line and a ventral one along its underside, each starting just behind the rump, widest (~0.045) at mid-tail and rounding off at the tip, with soft scalloped trailing edges like an axolotl's fin fold. Three small bodyShadow speckles dot the tail's upper surface. The tail tip's curl gives the silhouette a playful flick.
parts.attaches: Front end continues the torso's centreline at the tailRoot mount; fin membranes root onto the tail tube's own surface lines, riding the tail joints.

calls.reasoning:
I need to write a spec JSON for a chibi axolotl with frilly pink gills. Team of 3-6 builders, each builds one part. Let me design.

Axolotl: chibi style — big round head, tiny body, short stubby legs, wide smiling mouth, big dark eyes, external feathery gills (three pairs) sprouting from sides of head in pink frills. Colors: pale pink/cream body, darker pink gills, belly lighter. Maybe albino axolotl: near-white/pink body with pink gills and dark eyes.

Proportions: chibi — head huge (~50% of body length). Total length ~0.5m? Real axolotl ~25cm, chibi stylized. Let's do length ~0.55m, width ~0.35m, height ~0.3m. Standing on tiny stubby legs on y=0. Face +Z: head at front (+Z), body behind, tail tapering back to -Z with a tail fin.

Size: say [0.36, 0.32, 0.6] — width x, height y, length z. Head sphere ~0.26 diameter centered at z ~ +0.14, y ~0.16. Body under/behind head, tail extends to z=-0.3.

Gills: three stalks per side of head, each curved back, with frilly filament fans (membranes or small cards/spikes). Pink/magenta.

Layout parts:
1. headHead — big head sphere, face: eyes (big black beads with white highlights), smiley mouth (wide curve), nostrils, blush cheeks, top of head. Contains jaw as separate lower jaw for openable mouth? Creature rigging says mouth built as upper/lower jaw. Joints: head, jaw.
2. gillsL / gillsR — six gill stalks with frills. Could be one part "gills" covering both sides. Each gill: sprout from head with chain of 2, frilly filaments via membrane or small tapered spikes in pink/magenta gradient.
3. body — torso, belly, ventral side, small stubby legs with toes (4 legs). Legs: legs part.
4. tail — tapering tail with dorsal/ventral fin folds (membranes) and tail tip.
5. Maybe merge legs into body part.

Parts 3-6: head, gills, body (torso + legs), tail. That's 4 parts, or 5 with legs separate. Let's do 5: head, gills, torso, legs, tail. Budgets add ≤900; total maybe 300.

Skeleton joints:
- root "spine1" at body center? Chain: spine1 (hips, at [0, 0.14, -0.08], dir [0,0.3,1])... Let me define:
  - body (root, spine): at [0, 0.15, -0.05], dir [0, 0.25, 1]
  - neck/head: at [0, 0.17, 0.08] — head joint, role head
  - jaw: parent head, at [0, 0.10, 0.20], dir [0,-0.3,1], role jaw
  - gill chains: gillL1 parent head at [0.10, 0.20, 0.10]... Actually gills as chains with role "fan"? Roles list: spine neck head jaw hinge tail leg arm wing digit tentacle fan. Gills = tentacle or fan. Use tentacle chains gillL1..gillL3? Spec: joints list includes all joints. Each gill has 2 joints (base + tip). 6 gills × 2 = 12 joints. Plus legs: each leg chain: legFL with hipL, kneeL? Chibi stubby legs — single joint each maybe plus digit. Keep it simple: legL (role leg) per leg, 4 legs = 4 joints, maybe 2 per leg (hip + ankle). Tail: tail1..tail3 (role tail).

Joint list must be created in order, parents first. Each part lists joints its geometry rides.

Let me define coordinates concretely.

Keep 2 per leg: legFL (hip, role leg) and ankleFL (role hinge? digit). Toes are digits. Let's do leg joints only (4), each role leg; toes built as geometry on the leg joint.
